architecturePrinciples: Feature ownership defines scope, not lower quality.
Shared code requires real reuse or shared semantics.
Application routes consume feature public entrypoints.
Runtime environment access stays at explicit adapters; domain remains environment-free.
Design tokens have canonical authority and legacy compatibility may only shrink.
Application-wide regression composes authoritative checks without duplicating them.
Architectural decisions become executable gates when mechanically enforceable.
